data.source: FRED series TRUCKD (Truck Tonnage Index) weekly data

behavior: Truck tonnage index spikes or drops sharply week-over-week, signaling logistics capacity stress or demand collapse that precedes industrial sector moves.

market_impact.rationale: Sharp tonnage drops indicate manufacturing/logistics stress; spikes show demand surge that can lead to overheating.

trade_logic.entry: If TRUCKD weekly change exceeds ±3% from 4-week moving average
trade_logic.exit: Close position after 10 trading days or when weekly change reverts within ±1.5% of MA

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Weekly tonnage data is volatile with supply chain micro-shocks firing multiple times per month.

data.source: FRED series CIVPART (Civilian Labor Force Participation Rate) weekly

behavior: Unexpected weekly jumps or drops in labor force participation signal worker re-entry or exit, shifting wage/employment narrative and equity rotation.

market_impact.rationale: Rising participation eases wage pressure and supports consumer credit; financial sector reprices rate expectations.

trade_logic.entry: If weekly change in CIVPART exceeds ±0.15 percentage points from prior week
trade_logic.exit: After 8 trading days or when weekly change normalizes within ±0.05 pp

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Labor participation reports generate weekly moves; seasonal patterns and migration shifts fire this 2–3 times monthly.

data.source: Google Trends weekly search interest for 'store closing near me' + 'retail job cuts' combined index

behavior: Spikes in combined search interest for store closures and retail layoff news precede consumer discretionary drawdowns.

market_impact.rationale: Rising search for closures and cuts signals consumer avoidance behavior and discretionary pullback.

trade_logic.exit: After 12 trading days or when index falls below prior week baseline

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Retail news and store closure announcements spike weekly; threshold is loose enough to fire 3–4 times per month.

idea: Utility Demand Spike from Weather Extremes

data.source: Open-Meteo daily temperature anomaly (degree-days relative to 30-year normal) + EIA daily electricity demand

behavior: When daily temperature deviation exceeds 10°F from normal AND EIA electricity demand rises >5% day-over-day, utilities face margin compression or expansion.

market_impact.rationale: Extreme weather boosts utility revenues short-term but signals long-term grid stress; equity reprices dividend safety.

trade_logic.entry: If temp anomaly >10°F AND electricity demand >5% DoD spike
trade_logic.exit: After 6 trading days or when both conditions reverse

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Seasonal weather swings and demand spikes occur weekly; combined trigger fires 1–2 times per week on average.

data.source: USGS earthquake activity (magnitude >4.5) daily feed + XLB (materials ETF) price correlation

behavior: Major earthquake clusters in resource-rich regions trigger short-term supply chain jitters and insurance repricing, creating XLB volatility.

market_impact.rationale: Seismic events disrupt mining/logistics in commodity regions; materials sector reprices production and insurance costs.

trade_logic.entry: If USGS reports 2+ quakes >4.5 magnitude in resource regions within 48 hours AND XLB closes down >1%
trade_logic.exit: After 7 trading days or when USGS activity returns to baseline

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Seismic clusters in active zones occur monthly; threshold captures regional supply shocks.

data.source: OpenChargeMap EV charger counts (weekly snapshot) by region + XLK technology ETF price

behavior: Rapid week-over-week growth in charger deployments (>8%) signals infrastructure investment confidence and tech sector repricing.

market_impact.rationale: EV charging expansion signals tech/software/grid optimization demand; XLK reprices green tech secular growth.

trade_logic.entry: If charger count growth >8% WoW and XLK closes above 5-day MA
trade_logic.exit: After 10 trading days or when growth rate falls below 5%

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Regional charger rollouts occur weekly with seasonal acceleration; threshold fires 2–3 times per month.

idea: Credit Market Stress: Corporate Spread Widening Alert

data.source: FRED series BAMLH0A0HYM2 (HY Corporate OAS) daily

behavior: When high-yield spreads widen >50 bps in a single week, it signals credit stress and forces risk-off rotation into financials and staples.

market_impact.rationale: Widening credit spreads force financial sector to re-mark loan books; spreads are a leading indicator of economic stress.

trade_logic.entry: If weekly OAS change >+50 bps AND XLF closes below 5-day MA
trade_logic.exit: After 9 trading days or when spreads compress >30 bps intra-period

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Credit spreads move daily; weekly thresholds are hit 2–3 times per month during normal volatility.

data.source: Google Trends weekly search interest for 'prescription drug cost assistance' + 'medical debt relief'

behavior: Spikes in cost-assistance searches signal consumer healthcare distress and predict outpatient utilization drops and insurance margin pressure.

market_impact.rationale: Rising cost-assistance searches indicate affordability stress; healthcare providers repricing margins and utilization.

trade_logic.entry: If combined search index rises >20% WoW
trade_logic.exit: After 11 trading days or when index falls >15% from spike peak

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Drug pricing news and healthcare policy announcements fire weekly spikes; threshold is accessible 2–4 times per month.

data.source: BTS (Bureau of Transportation Statistics) weekly airline load factor and capacity utilization

behavior: When weekly airline load factor drops >2% from 4-week moving average, it signals demand collapse in leisure/business travel.

market_impact.rationale: Falling load factors indicate weak discretionary spending and business travel; consumer discretionary reprices.

trade_logic.entry: If load factor drops >2% from 4-week MA AND XLY closes down >0.8%
trade_logic.exit: After 8 trading days or when load factor recovers >1% toward MA

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Seasonal travel demand varies weekly; threshold fires 1–2 times per month during normal cycles.

data.source: FRED series MMNRNJ (Producer Price Index: Intermediate Materials) weekly

behavior: When weekly PPI intermediate goods rise >1% WoW, it signals input cost compression upstream and forces energy/basic materials repricing.

market_impact.rationale: Input price spikes push energy/materials sector margins higher short-term and reprices commodity hedges.

trade_logic.entry: If weekly PPI change >+1.0% AND XLE closes above 5-day MA
trade_logic.exit: After 10 trading days or when PPI reverts >0.5% in opposite direction

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Commodity shocks and PPI volatility spike weekly; threshold is accessible 2–3 times per month.
